cases.positive_dependency: source current running probe precedes dependent Release; both markers execute
cases.pending_exec: bounded queries may reach running; Release alone is never ready
cases.dead_prerequisite: source killed after ready; dependent marker absent and readiness invalid
cases.issuer_loss: original helper loss rejects dependent; no PID adoption
cases.forged_handle: changed complete handle rejected before Query/Release
cases.unsupported_probe: non-running catalog condition rejected at construction
cases.stale_reply: expired observation cannot authorize dependent Release
cases.final_guard: loss after initial probes but before final Release check blocks workload
cases.duplicate_start: second start rejected; no second workload
cases.health_loss: sampled health failure invalidates observations and closes starts
cases.identity: copied facade/changed session/registry rejected before effect
cases.conflict_cancel: normal lock conflict fails promptly; cancellation independent
cases.bootstrap_session: changed public session rejected before native request
